create_ImageLoss: create an ImageLoss module to compute classification and bounding box losses for DETR-style object detection models
run_HungarianMatcher: run the HungarianMatcher to compute optimal assignments between predicted and ground-truth bounding boxes
compute_dice_loss: compute the DICE loss between predicted masks and binary ground-truth mask targets
compute_sigmoid_focal_loss: compute the sigmoid focal loss with alpha and gamma parameters for handling class imbalance in detection
run_ForObjectDetectionLoss: run ForObjectDetectionLoss to compute weighted classification and box losses for object detection training
